test_title: PYST 5: SSC CPO - General Intelligence and Reasoning (Held On 11 Dec, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
The sequence of folding a piece of paper and the manner in which it is folded has been cut as shown in the following figure. How would this paper look when unfolded?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/377a83a5645a41016c6f53f86ea5f238ddb633e83918e7855b204fb2f88cb9bb.png]
solution:
The paper after unfolded will be:

A perfectly symmetrical pattern formed due to reflections across both diagonal folds, producing equal distribution of shapes in all four quadrants.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3b267b8d236e8685929b4b09a7abf321beb17f78e6064b670fa28cbeed6fa859.png] 

This results in:

4 circles placed symmetrically

4 diamonds alternating with circles

4 squares forming a central symmetric arrangement

Hence, the correct answer is **Option 3.**
